home_description: A cross-platform desktop toolbox designed to provide you with an efficient and convenient workflow.
subtitle_tool_description: AI translation, format conversion, and other subtitle processing features.
rename_tool_description: Easily rename multiple files in bulk.
music_tool_description: Convert paid music to FLAC/MP3 format.
cross_platform_description: Built with Electron, supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux with a consistent native experience.
feature_fast_description: Optimized architecture and efficient processing pipelines, delivering blazing-fast performance and responsiveness.
feature_secure_description: All data is processed locally without uploading to the cloud, ensuring your privacy and security.

suggestion_extract_chinese_prompt: Extract Chinese content from bilingual subtitles in ~/Downloads

capabilities_description: Plan and use connected tools in this conversation. The Agent will explain when files, configuration or confirmation are needed.
capability_studio_description: Import subtitles, inspect documents and tasks, and prepare translation to continue in the studio.
capability_knowledge_description: Find collections and plans to prepare consistent terminology and translation requirements.
capability_translator_description: Scan subtitles, queue translation in batches, and recover unfinished translations.
capability_converter_description: Queue subtitle conversion between SRT, LRC, VTT and other supported formats.
capability_extractor_description: Extract the requested language from bilingual subtitles using this task's selection.
capability_local_description: Check the local runtime, prepare media transcription and inspect task progress.
capability_names_description: Inspect paths, preview translated names and rename after explicit confirmation, or continue reviewing in the tool.
